stories.title: Cloudflare Detects Early Exploitation Attempts Targeting Two Leaked PHP Vulnerabilities
stories.description: Cloudflare says it is seeing early attempts to exploit two critical PHP vulnerabilities whose details surfaced before the PHP security team’s planned release.

stories.title: Hackers Use Claude AI to Plan Ransomware Attacks, Then Accidentally Expose Their Secrets

stories.title: Browsers Block eMudhra Intermediate CAs Over Recoverable Private Keys
stories.description: The private keys associated with eight certificates were compromised, and root programs and trust stores are blocking them.

stories.title: Fortinet FortiSIEM RCE Vulnerability Gets Public Exploit That Requires No Login
stories.description: A public PoC exploit targets a critical Fortinet FortiSIEM flaw enabling unauthenticated remote code execution and file writes.

stories.title: China Defends DeepSeek After US Ban of Its AI From Government Systems
stories.description: The DHS said agencies should remove DeepSeek products as well as third-party products and services developed using DeepSeek from their IT systems.

stories.title: PHP2Shell: What Actually Protects You Before the 14:00 UTC PHP RCE Patch, and What Doesn't

stories.title: The Harness Is the Hard Part of Agentic Pentesting
stories.description: Pentera Apps uses a deterministic harness to control AI web app pentesting, log actions, and produce replayable exploit scripts for validation.

stories.title: Attackers Hijacked Over 300 Tor Exit Relays to Intercept SSH Connections
stories.description: Attackers hijacked over 300 Tor exit relays to intercept SSH connections and steal passwords from users who accepted changed host keys.

stories.title: Chinese AI Model Writes More Hackable Code When Told It’s for US Contractor
